# Phobos Agriculture: equipment and item reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-item-reference.ps1. Edit config/item-reference.json, not this file. -->

Current source candidate: **0.9.0**. Game target: **1.0.1.5**. Values below come from offline definitions; they do not establish installation, gameplay validation or a live merchant quote.

Verdemorrow equipment grows potatoes and lettuce, cooks potato portions and manages finite irrigation. These are authored, accelerated gameplay systems. Crop yields and simplified nutrient/treatment chemistry are not research results. The linked research guide attributes the supporting work separately; none of the pricing or yield balance implies NASA/ESA endorsement. See [research and attribution](agriculture-research.md).

**Reading prices:** credits per complete object at the stated condition, before shop margins, market effects, negotiation and extra wear. Pristine retail can cost more. Mass is the empty/dry definition or fresh commodity template; saved contents and variable recovery packets can weigh differently. Dismantle value is the sum of all listed outputs at base value, excluding labour and tools.

**Repair and Restore:** Repair fixes a damaged form and retains the actual consumed service materials as spent parts. Restore reduces wear on functional equipment in place; it does not grant pristine status. Empty cargo and follow the machine’s local maintenance guards first. Work speed depends on crew, tools and current condition.

**Finding stock:** the generated percentages are defaults per eligible native stock/loot roll, not per ship or guaranteed shop availability. Offers are additive, may be independent, and require normal restocking. Loot branches choose at most one added item per branch. Configuration, capacity and native generation rules still apply; loading an existing save does not refill its inventories.

<a id="rack"></a>

## Firstlight-4 Cultivation Rack

Grows one potato, food-lettuce or lettuce-seed cohort across four visual trays.

**Use:** Install and power the rack, load irrigation and nutrients, then perform Plant. Keep cabin conditions suitable and Harvest when ready. Remove output cargo before replanting.

**Where it appears:** Buy equipment or build at a supported table; used/refurbished/damaged offers are listed below.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Four trays are one cohort. Food lettuce does not return seeds; choose the dedicated seed cycle. The local panel shows inventory, stress and progress.

Full operating instructions: [Firstlight-4 Cultivation Rack guide](agriculture-player-guide.md).

<a id="cooker"></a>

## Hearth-2 Galley Cooker

Cooks a raw potato portion into edible prepared food.

**Use:** Install, power, place raw potatoes in its Inventory and Start. Collect the cooked portion when complete.

**Where it appears:** Buy equipment or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Its counter and stove artwork are one machine. Each job binds a particular raw portion; replacing it does not transfer progress.

Full operating instructions: [Hearth-2 Galley Cooker guide](agriculture-player-guide.md).

<a id="supply"></a>

## Groundwork W2 Water Supply Unit

Stores and supplies irrigation water or formulated nutrient solution; also treats recorded process solution.

**Use:** Install and power W2, load supplies locally, choose formulation, pair supported racks and explicitly enable receiving/distribution. Use treatment controls for recorded drainage and a cartridge. Select a physical nutrient charge while paused for gradual consumption during powered blending.

**Where it appears:** Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Use separate circuits for incompatible formulations. Receiving pauses after reload. Optional [Valtora’s Ship’s Water](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3757331189) integration is version-scoped and protects crew reserves; manual input remains available.

Full operating instructions: [Groundwork W2 Water Supply Unit guide](fluid-network-operations.md).

<a id="irrigation-pipe"></a>

## Groundwork Irrigation Conduit

Carries irrigation water or crop nutrient solution between W2 and paired racks.

**Use:** Place contiguous segments in MISC, connect the endpoint sockets and use Pair/Receive controls.

**Where it appears:** Buy stock, build at a supported table, or find a loose segment in eligible locked-crate contents.

**Placement:** INSTALL → MISC. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Separate from electricity and F6 coolant. Removing a line does not delete the contents retained at its receiving endpoint.

Full operating instructions: [Groundwork Irrigation Conduit guide](agriculture-water-conduits.md).

<a id="recorded-solution"></a>

## Recorded Process Solution

Drainage with saved water/nutrient quantities that W2 can validate.

**Use:** Place alongside a usable treatment cartridge in W2; queue drainage treatment, then Start and provide power/output space.

**Where it appears:** New recorded drainage and retained solution recovery.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Live mass/composition comes from the saved batch. Recovery is partial, with terminal rejects, and never returns drinking water.

Full operating instructions: [Recorded Process Solution guide](fluid-network-operations.md).

<a id="workup-bench"></a>

## Groundwork B2 Workup Bench

Recovers recorded crop nutrients and formulates finite W2 mixtures.

**Use:** Install through APPS, power, load a recorded residue packet, prepare recovery and Start. Then prepare recovered concentrate plus equal-mass makeup salts and Start. Leave output room.

**Where it appears:** Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or construct at a supported table.

**Placement:** INSTALL → APPS. Obtain the loose item first; the menu does not manufacture it.

Each stage binds physical inputs, consumes power and pauses after reload. Damaged hardware is repairable; consumable contents are not.

Full operating instructions: [Groundwork B2 Workup Bench guide](agriculture-nutrient-production.md).

## Recorded Crop Residue

Retained wet crop matter with a bounded saved nutrient allocation.

**Use:** Process at B2; empty or unrecorded nutrient budgets are not eligible.

**Where it appears:** Harvest or clear a cohort planted from Agriculture 0.9.0 onward.

**Placement:** Inventory/module-slot item; no standalone INSTALL entry.

Actual mass and allocation vary. Old residue and old cohorts are not reassayed.

## Evidence and upkeep

Item names, dry/template masses, prices, service bills, salvage outputs, placement tabs, stock probabilities and table recipes are generated from current Phobos definitions. **Blue Bottle Games’ Ostranauts** native `DataCO.GetBasePrice` supplies the offline valuation used here ([developer’s game page](https://bluebottlegames.com/games/ostranauts)). That page identifies the game; the actual numeric evidence is the locally inspected assembly, whose hash is retained in the generated data snapshot. No proprietary source or game assembly is distributed.

Function/use explanations are maintained in the reviewed catalogue. All fictional prices, yields and simplified processing are Phobos gameplay choices. Research attribution remains beside the relevant claims in the linked operating/research guides. See [reference maintenance](item-reference-maintenance.md) for the one-click updater and coverage checks.
